name: Jane Austen's Miss Emma
source:
Matchmaking is your recipe for success, but you have no idea that you too can get caught in the intricate love web you keep weaving for others. What effect will the love potion with the taste of passion have on you? Be prepared to lose your heart, because what you'll gain instead will be priceless.

[From in-app]
translation:
撮合姻缘是你的拿手好戏，但你从未想过，自己也会陷入亲手为他人编织的复杂情网。带着激情滋味的爱情魔药，会在你身上产生怎样的效果？准备好交出真心吧，因为你将收获的，是无价之宝。

[摘自应用内介绍]
